title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription options follow meeting policies
summary: The rollout information and documented meeting-policy controls are supported. The licensing discussion needs one correction: licensing for the new change is unpublished, but Microsoft already documents that Education A1 customers cannot use the existing automatic recording and transcription option.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: The policy-aligned menu change is enabled automatically without administrator action.
claims.quote: No admin action is required; the feature is enabled automatically as part of the service update.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licence requirement, price or meter specifically for the new policy-alignment change and Record only option has not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams "Record only" "automatic" license Premium pricing transcription meeting options; read MC1508234, roadmap record, manage-teams-auto-recording, meeting-recording, and Teams Premium licensing search excerpts. No change-specific licence or meter found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Neither the supplied roadmap item nor MC1508234 names a licence or meter.
claims.quote: Searched: licence, license, meter and price in the supplied roadmap record and complete Message Center post MC1508234; neither record names one.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; controls[0].note; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Only organisers with Teams Premium can use assigned meeting templates.
claims.quote: Only organizers with a Teams Premium license can use assigned meeting templates.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy with Identity and AutoRecording Enabled or Disabled controls whether organisers can access automatic recording.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Enabled
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Disabled

claims.claim: No direct administrator UI for the AutoRecording policy is documented on the cited surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AutoRecording admin center meeting template PowerShell manage automatic recording; opened manage-teams-auto-recording and read manage-meeting-recording-options excerpts. PowerShell controls policy availability; templates are a separate management route.

claims.claim: The cited Learn page says this setting must be managed through PowerShell or a meeting template.
claims.quote: You must use PowerShell or a meeting template to manage this setting for organizers.
claims.fix: Retain the attribution, but note that https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-meeting-recording-options#record-and-transcribe-automatically also documents sensitivity labels for enforcing automatic recording. Cite that page and distinguish enforcement from the AutoRecording availability policy.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy with Identity and AllowCloudRecording controls meeting recording permission.
claims.quote: To manage meeting recording by using PowerShell, use the -AllowCloudRecording parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.

claims.claim: The recording control is in Teams admin center under Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select an existing policy or create a new one.
Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy with Identity and AllowTranscription controls meeting transcription permission.
claims.quote: To manage meeting transcription using PowerShell, use the -AllowTranscription parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.

claims.claim: The transcription control is in Teams admin center under Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: No separate tenant-wide switch for the new policy alignment or Record only option is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams automatic recording transcription "Record only" tenant disable new options license webinar town hall; opened manage-teams-auto-recording and meeting-recording, read manage-meeting-recording-options excerpts and MC1508234. No separate switch found.

claims.claim: Teams meeting policies can be assigned to specific users or groups through the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To specific users: Select your policy, select Manage users > Assign users ... To groups: Go to the Group policy assignment tab, select Add, enter the group name, select the policy name, and then select Apply.

claims.claim: Transcription permission is checked for the initiating user as well as the organiser.
claims.quote: For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.where: Open questions: licensing; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Whether any licence is required for the automatic setting itself is entirely not yet published.
claims.quote: Customers with a Microsoft 365 Education A1 subscription don't have the option to record and transcribe meetings automatically.
claims.fix: Keep licensing.model unknown for this change, but narrow the licensing question to additional requirements for the new alignment and Record only choice. Add the documented baseline exclusion: Microsoft 365 Education A1 customers cannot record and transcribe meetings automatically. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-meeting-recording-options#record-and-transcribe-automatically and distinguish this existing restriction from the unpublished licensing of the update.
